script.text: After the duel with Alister, Kaiba went to Pegasus' company, Industrial Illusions, to look for answers. There, he encountered Yugi and his friends.
Oh great. Any sign of Pegasus?
Uh uh. I'm afraid we were too late.
That's right. Believe it or not, Mai Valentine got to him before we did. She took his soul with some Orichalcos thing.
Yugi boy! At least I hope it's you that found this room. If you're hearing this, that can only mean the gentlemen who are after my soul were finally able to capture me. So please listen closely.
It all began when a mysterious man tried to buy out my company. But there's more. This individual possesses an ancient power stronger than any I've seen. And his name... is Dartz.
He's trying to resurrect the most terrifying beast ever to roam the earth – the great Leviathan – by draining the souls of man and beast.
If his plan works, Dartz will have succeeded in unleashing a truly devastating power. The likes of which has not been seen for 10,000 years.
Time is running out. My cute little Duel Monsters will soon be gone, along with the rest of the world. Only you can save the poor creatures that made my game famous!
